title: Week 6 risers and fallers in the MFPI
dek: The largest statewide rank moves this week, with the verified results and rating changes behind each one.
author: MFPI automated analysis

sources.label: MHSAA official score center (schedules and scores)
Statewide media rankings used for the Media Rank inputs

limitations: Movement is only shown against a comparable previous snapshot; teams without one are NEW.
Large moves in the middle of the table often reflect tightly bunched ratings rather than dramatic results.

sections.heading: How to read these moves
paragraphs: Rank movement is last week's statewide rank minus this week's. Rating change is this week's displayed MFPI minus last week's. They are separate facts: in the middle of the table, where ratings are close together, a small rating change can move a team many places, and a team can hold its place while its rating changes.
Both compare the Week 6 snapshot with the latest audited Week 5 snapshot (formula MFPI-3.2).

sections.heading: Biggest risers

sections.heading: Data notes and limitations
paragraphs: Snapshot generated October 6, 2026 at 11:22 AM Central with a cutoff of October 6 at 11:00 AM Central, formula MFPI-3.2.
663 of 675 game listings due by the cutoff had verified scores (98.2%); the rest count as unavailable, never as losses or 0-0 results.
Opponent ranks in this article are the opponent's rank in this snapshot, not its rank on the day the game was played, unless a sentence says otherwise.
